verdict.rationale: Convertio's own docs say its video converter lets users choose quality, aspect ratio, codec and other settings, and it claims conversions across more than 300 formats. So video transcoding with codec control is documented. Bitrate and resolution are not named explicitly ('quality' and 'aspect ratio' only imply them), and audio-specific controls are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit bitrate control, explicit resolution control, documented audio codec/bitrate settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution

citations.quote: with a video converter you can choose quality, aspect ratio, codec and other settings, rotate and flip.
We support more than 25600 different conversions between more than 300 different file formats.
